mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_message (type, title, content, sender_id, sender_type, target_type, target_id, related_id) VALUES (#{message.type}, #{message.title}, #{message.content}, #{message.senderId}, #{message.senderType}, #{message.targetType}, #{message.targetId}, #{message.relatedId})
